question: ______ unemployment occurs with changes in economic activity over the business cycle.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cyclical__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cyclical unemployment** is a shortage of employment brought on by fluctuations in the **business cycle** of an economy.
 
• High unemployment rates are primarily a result of **cyclical unemployment.**
 
• It results from a contraction in the business cycle.
 
• It is a normal cycle of economic growth's ups and downs that happens over time.
 
• **Temporary cyclical unemploymen**t is based on how long an** economic downturn** brought on by a recession lasts.
 
• You should anticipate frequent changes in the economy if you work in business or finance.
 
• These cycles may have a big impact on spending, which could harm your business or sector.
